resources.note: Card (a): the area under (4−x²)^½ between 1 and 2 is a circular segment (sector − triangle) found by circle geometry before any calculus (clause b); the paired calculus card makes this a methods-contrast exemplar (Mode-4: compare-before-compute).

resources.title: When will the arclength $QR$ take a maximum value?
resources.note: Arc QR of a circle centred at P with radius PQ (itself a chord length of circle X): arc length s = rθ is the modelled object; the maximisation rides 1.7 (clause b; calculus extension recorded).

resources.title: Belt

resources.title: What's the area of this square if it sits in this sector?
